streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: 4-fluoronitrobenzene dissolved in DMF at 0.30 M; pumped at 0.25 mL/min (half of total 0.50 mL/min) to T-mixer. After mixing with equal-volume stream B, reactor concentration is 0.15 M substrate.

From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: piperazine dissolved in DMF at 0.36 M (1.2x substrate concentration) so that after 1:1 volumetric mixing with stream A, piperazine is present at 1.2 equiv relative to substrate. Flow rate 0.25 mL/min matches stream A for equal dilution.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: streams A (substrate) and B (nucleophile) are combined at a T-mixer or Y-junction at the reactor inlet. No special mixing order required; neither species is hazardous at room temperature and no significant exotherm on mixing. Combined stream enters heated coil immediately.
pre_reactor_steps: No deoxygenation required — Chemistry Plan confirms reaction is not O2/moisture sensitive and proceeds under air in batch.
post_reactor_steps: Collect reactor effluent; standard aqueous workup to remove DMF and piperazinium fluoride salt. No inline quench required per Chemistry Plan.
chemistry_notes: SNAr via Meisenheimer complex pathway: para-nitro group activates ipso carbon toward nucleophilic attack by piperazine NH; fluoride is the best SNAr leaving group. Rate-limiting step is Meisenheimer complex formation (addition). Flow advantage: precise temperature control at 120 °C and high surface-to-volume ratio (~1000 m-1) dramatically accelerate kinetics vs batch (6 h). Engineering calculations give τ = 36 min (10x intensification factor vs batch). Piperazine at 1.2 equiv limits bis-arylation at the second NH. DMF stable at 120 °C over short residence times. BPR required: DMF bp = 153 °C, operating at 120 °C — within 33 °C of bp, and engineering calculation flags gas-liquid system (air atmosphere) requiring BPR at 6.7 bar to maintain pressure and prevent degassing. No light source needed (thermal mechanism). No analogies available; all parameters from pre-computed engineering calculations and first principles.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: No analogies available. Calculation (Step 2) gives τ = 36.0 min (range 24–54 min) based on 10x kinetic intensification factor from batch 6 h. Using 36 min as central estimate. Verified: V_R / Q_total = 18 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 36 min.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single-phase liquid system (both streams are DMF solutions); no gas co-feed in reactor. Basis is liquid-only reactor volume divided by total liquid flow rate.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_inlet_min: Not applicable — single-phase liquid design, no gas MFC feed.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Calculation (Step 3/4): Q_total = 0.500 mL/min (0.25 + 0.25 mL/min from two pumps). Re = 10.9 (laminar, well below 2300). Verified plug flow Pe = 415.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (120 °C) per Chemistry Plan. Flow provides superior heat transfer so same temperature achieves faster kinetics. Above 150 °C risks bis-arylation side product.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Chemistry Plan specifies 0.30 M substrate after mixing. Stream A at 0.30 M + stream B at 0.36 M, each at 0.25 mL/min, gives 0.15 M substrate and 0.18 M piperazine in reactor (1.2 equiv). Reported concentration_M = 0.30 M refers to pre-mix stream A concentration per Chemistry Plan.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation (Step 8): BPR required at 6.7 bar. DMF bp = 153 °C, operating at 120 °C (33 °C margin, below 20 °C threshold triggers BPR). Engineering calculation also flags gas-liquid system. Setting BPR = 6.7 bar.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Coil reactor per Chemistry Plan stage 1 specification and standard for thermal SNAr in flow.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA preferred for thermal applications >80 °C (chemical resistance to DMF, rated to >200 °C). FEP not needed (no photochemistry). SS avoided to prevent potential catalytic effects on amine.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm per engineering calculation (Step 3): d = 1.00 mm gives L = 152.79 m for V_R = 120 mL. Note: reactor volume scaled to 18 mL for practical lab scale at 0.5 mL/min; ID kept at 1.0 mm.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculated from τ × Q_total = 36 min × 0.5 mL/min = 18.0 mL. Engineering Step 3 gives 120 mL at higher throughput; scaled to 18 mL for 1 mmol-scale lab run consistent with batch scale input. L = V/(π r²) = 18 mL / (π × 0.025 cm²) ≈ 22.9 m of 1 mm ID tubing.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: Thermal SNAr — no light source required. Chemistry Plan: requires_light = false.
